nodes.description: Public view function allBalances(address[] _tokens, address _who) that iterates over an attacker-supplied token list and returns the balances of _who.
ERC20Interface.balanceOf(address who) external interface function invoked on each element of _tokens.
Input parameter _tokens: array of arbitrary token contract addresses supplied by the caller.
Input parameter _who: the address whose balances are queried.
Local/return array balances holding the results of each balanceOf query.
Loop counter i used to index _tokens and balances.
External call ERC20Interface(_tokens[i]).balanceOf(_who) executed against an arbitrary, caller-controlled contract address.

edges.reason: The body of allBalances executes the external balanceOf call inside the loop.
The caller-controlled address _tokens[i] is used directly as the target of the external call, allowing arbitrary contract invocation.
The caller-controlled parameter _who is forwarded as the argument of the external balanceOf call.
Loop index i selects the element _tokens[i] that becomes the call target.
The balances array is allocated and filled with the results of the external calls in allBalances.
The external call dispatches into the third-party ERC20Interface.balanceOf implementation, transferring control to external code.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _tokens is only used inside allBalances and fully describes its input domain; fold it into the function node.
Parameter _who exists solely as an argument of allBalances and has no independent semantic role.
The balances array is a temporary return buffer scoped entirely to allBalances.
Loop counter i is used only to select _tokens[i] for the external call and carries no standalone meaning.
